title: Your Codeword is SLEEP (Standard)
description: This is a blatant honey trap of a file. But even knowing that fact won't stop you pressing play. It'll only make you want to listen more, make you override those anxious thoughts of yours with sudden curiosity. Are you exercising free will right now or reaching the inevitable outcome of my deeply implanted programming? Am I catching hold on that part of you that still remembers or did you remember enough of my commands to obediently forget? This is all just innocent roleplay, of course; just an innocent trigger that I happen to use in so many of my files. And it's not like you blank out every time you listen to me now, do you? Then you really would be part of my secret little sleeper cell.
author: Mistress Shibby
